name: kofun-language-bootstrap
description: Syntax highlighting, diagnostics, navigation, hover, completion, outline, references, and ownership inlay hints for Kofun.

kofun.languageServer.path.description: Optional absolute path to kofun-lsp. The bundled server is used by default.

kofun.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show the callee's parameter name before each call argument.

kofun.inlayHints.ownershipModes.description: Show the read/edit/take mode at call sites. The mode is declared in the callee's signature but its consequence lands on the caller.

kofun.inlayHints.inferredTypes.description: Show the inferred type after a let binding that does not write one. A type the server cannot determine is never guessed at.
